
***Versions used***

miniupnpc: is release version 1.4
freetype: local edit marked "DV edit" in src/base/ftbase.c, it includes ftwinfnt.c (FT_Get_WinFNT_Header, which MyGUI uses and no other part of the build compiled)
MyGui: is version 3.5.4 from https://github.com/MyGUI/mygui/releases/tag/v3.5.4 (MIT licence, COPYING.MIT; the 3.2.0 tree it replaces was LGPL). Parts that are part of this code base: the engine (MyGUIEngine, module MyGUI.Engine) with the data of the standard skins, fonts and shaders (MyGUIEngine/data, the Media/MyGUI_Media directory of upstream without the DirectX 11, Vulkan and OpenSceneGraph shaders, with the MSDF font shaders described at msdfgen), the platforms OpenGL (MyGUI.OpenGLPlatform, legacy), OpenGL3 (MyGUI.OpenGL3Platform), OpenGLES (MyGUI.OpenGLESPlatform, OpenGL ES 3 and WebGL 2) and Ogre (MyGUI.OgrePlatform), and Platforms/Utils/FileSystemInfo.h (module MyGUI.Common.FileSystemInfo). The other parts of upstream (the DirectX 9 and 11, Vulkan, OgreNext, OpenSceneGraph and Dummy platforms, Common, Demos, AdvancedDemos, Tools, UnitTests, Wrappers, Docs, the other media) are not part of it; the tools of the old 3.2.0 tree (FontViewer, ImageSetViewer, LayoutEditor, SkinEditor) did not build here (OIS, gdiplus) and are dropped. The CMakeLists.txt and .list files of upstream are kept as _CMakeLists.txt and *.list. MyGUI_Config.h, which the upstream CMake build generates, is a hand written equivalent in MyGUIEngine/include. MyGUI needs C++17, its modules and everything that depends on them state that with MinCppStandard in their ModuleInfo.xml. MyGUI reads its resources through its DataManager: the GUI drivers of this code base implement it over the virtual file system (the OpenGL drivers) or use the resource system of Ogre (the Ogre driver), and give images to the OpenGL platforms through gucefIMAGE. The data of the module is deployed to data/MyGUI.Engine of the build and mounted as MyGUI.Engine. Local edits marked "DV edit" in Platforms/OpenGLPlatform/include/MyGUI_GL.h and Platforms/OpenGL3Platform/include/MyGUI_GL.h (on Windows the OpenGL functions come from glew, which is part of this code base, instead of glad)
zzlib version is: 0.13.49
zlib version is: 1.3.2 from https://zlib.net (local edits marked "DV edit" in zconf.h)
minizip is the contrib/minizip (with ZIP64) of zlib 1.3.2, only the zip, unzip and ioapi sources
libarchive is version 3.8.9 from https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/releases (signature verified), configured for zlib only, see libarchive/libarchive/config.h
FreeImage version is: 3110
freetype is actually Freetype2 which is version 2.6.3
pcre is version 8.37
CEGUI is version 0.8.3

LUA is version 5.3.4
Little-CMS is version >=2.8 HEAD from https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS
DevIL is version 1.8.0, see https://github.com/DentonW/DevIL
toluapp is a LUA 5.3 patched version from : https://github.com/waltervn/toluapp
hiredis is version 1.0.2 from https://github.com/redis/hiredis
redis-plus-plus is version 1.3.9 from https://github.com/sewenew/redis-plus-plus
librdkafka is version 2.3.0 from https://github.com/confluentinc/librdkafka/releases/tag/v2.3.0
OIS is at version 1.3 and can be obtained from http://sourceforge.net/projects/wgois
json-parser is at version 1.1.0 and can be obtained from https://github.com/udp/json-parser
zookeeper-client-c is from Zookeeper version 3.5.6 source tar dated 2019-10-16 00:35
curl is release version 8.23.0 from https://github.com/curl/curl/releases (signature verified), TLS via system OpenSSL on Linux and Schannel on Windows, see lib/curl_config.h
stbrumme-hash-library is version 8 from https://github.com/stbrumme/hash-library obtained source dated 2022-01-22
Protocol Buffers is at release v21.12 from https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/releases/tag/v21.12
aws-cpp-sdk-core is version 1.10.51 from GitHub (Jan 13th 2023) @ https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-cpp/releases/tag/1.10.51
aws-cpp-sdk-s3 is version 1.10.51 from GitHub (Jan 13th 2023) @ https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-cpp/releases/tag/1.10.51
aws-cpp-sdk-sqs is version 1.10.51 from GitHub (Jan 13th 2023) @ https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-cpp/releases/tag/1.10.51
aws-cpp-sdk-sns is version 1.10.51 from GitHub (Jan 13th 2023) @ https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-cpp/releases/tag/1.10.51
aws-cpp-sdk-secretsmanager is version 1.10.51 from GitHub (Jan 13th 2023) @ https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-cpp/releases/tag/1.10.51
aws-cpp-sdk-core/s3/sns/sqs/secretsmanager: local edit marked "DV edit" in the *_EXPORTS.h headers, on non-Windows the API macros export symbols explicitly since our builds hide them by default
aws-crt-cpp (aws-checksums): local edit marked "DV edit" in source/intel/asm/crc32c_sse42_asm.c, GCC without optimization uses the software CRC since its inline assembly does not compile unoptimized
aws-lambda-runtime is version 0.2.7 from GitHub @ https://github.com/awslabs/aws-lambda-cpp/releases/tag/v0.2.7
libyaml is in-flight version 0.2.6 from GitHub @ https://github.com/yaml/libyaml obtained source dated 2023-04-23
opentelemetry-cpp is version 1.21.0 from GitHub
RmlUI is version 6.2 from GitHub @ https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi/releases/tag/6.2
imgui is Dear ImGui version 1.93.0 of the master line (no docking, no multi viewports) from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/tag/v1.93.0 (MIT licence, LICENSE.txt). Everything of the release is part of this code base except examples/libs (prebuilt Windows libraries of GLFW) and the .github folder; the module imgui builds imgui.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_tables.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp, imgui_demo.cpp and imgui_gucef.cpp, the folders backends, examples, docs and misc are excluded in ProjectGenExcludeList.txt. It is a shared library (a static library on the web) so that the application, the GUI driver library guidriverImGui and its renderer plugins share one current context (GImGui), one allocator and one set of globals; the module states MinCppStandard 11 and builds below C++11 skip it and every module that depends on it. Local edit marked "DV edit" in imconfig.h (option A of upstream: the file is kept on update): IMGUI_API exports on Windows by IMGUI_BUILD_MODULE and gives default visibility elsewhere, IMGUI_IMPL_API is empty (backends are compiled into the plugins), ImDrawIdx is unsigned int (32-bit indices), IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32, IMGUI_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS, IMGUI_DISABLE_STB_TRUETYPE (fonts are rasterized by the gucefGUI font rasterizers), IMGUI_DISABLE_FILE_FUNCTIONS (files go through the VFS), IMGUI_DISABLE_DEFAULT_SHELL_FUNCTIONS, IMGUI_DISABLE_WIN32_FUNCTIONS, IMGUI_DISABLE_DEMO_WINDOWS when NDEBUG is defined unless GUCEF_IMGUI_KEEP_DEMO is, and IM_ASSERT and IMGUI_DEBUG_PRINTF call GucefImGui_AssertFailed and GucefImGui_DebugPrintf. Added files marked "DV edit": imgui_gucef.h and imgui_gucef.cpp, the forwarders of those two hooks to handlers which guidriverImGui sets (the module has no link to the GUCEF libraries). Upgrade checklist: keep imconfig.h, imgui_gucef.h and imgui_gucef.cpp; check imgui_internal.h first, since guidriverImGui uses its internal API (ImFontLoader, ImFontAtlasPackAddRect, ImFontAtlasPackGetRect, ImFontAtlasBakedSetFontGlyphBitmap, ImFontAtlasBuilder::TempBuffer and the assertion of ImFontAtlas::AddFont() that FontLoaderData is NULL in guidriverImGui_CImGuiFontLoader.cpp; RegisterUserTexture, UnregisterUserTexture and the destroy protocol of user textures (WantDestroyNextFrame, UnusedFrames) in guidriverImGui_CImGuiTextureCache.cpp; ImGuiContext::ErrorCallback and the platform IO hooks in guidriverImGui_CImGuiContext.cpp); compare the texture protocol (ImTextureData, ImTextureStatus) with guidriverImGui_CImGuiSoftwareRenderer.cpp; run tests/guidriverImGui_TestApp The OpenGL 3 renderer backend of Dear ImGui (backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp, imgui_impl_opengl3.h and imgui_impl_opengl3_loader.h of the release) is also copied, without changes, into plugins/GUI/guidriverImGuiOpenGL (src and include), with its MIT notice in the LICENSE.txt of that plugin; the plugin feeds the loader of the backend with the function of the window (imgl3wInit2) and defines IMGUI_IMPL_OPENGL_ES3 on Android and the web. On an upgrade copy these three files again and run tests/guidriverImGuiOpenGL_TestApp (and, for the Ogre renderer, compare the texture protocol with guidriverImGuiOgre_CImGuiOgreRenderer.cpp and run tests/guidriverImGuiOgre_TestApp).
jasper: local edit marked "DV edit" in src/libjasper/include/jasper/jas_config.h, the values of a POSIX system instead of cmake template lines
tiff: local edit marked "DV edit" in libtiff/tif_config.h, io.h and setmode() only on Windows, unistd.h and snprintf() elsewhere
openexr: local edits marked "DV edit" in IlmBase/config.windows/IlmBaseConfig.h and OpenEXR/config.windows/OpenEXRConfig.h, pthreads, POSIX semaphores and sysconf() on non-Windows. The Win32 thread sources are only part of the build on Windows (IlmBase/IlmThread/ProjectGenInstructions.xml)
FreeImage: local edits marked "DV edit": LibJXR/image/sys/ansi.h (byteswap declaration and wchar.h for ANSI platforms), LibRawLite/internal/dcraw_common.cpp (powf64 renamed dcraw_powf64 since glibc has a function by that name), LibJXR/jxrgluelib/JXRGlueJxr.c (wchar.h). The processor specific WebP code for other architectures is excluded in LibWebP/src/dsp/ProjectGenInstructions.xml
DevIL: the Linux config include/IL/linux/config.h was renamed DevILconfig.h like the Windows one and had its Windows specifics removed (marked "DV edit"). The older il_exr.c and il_utx.c, which are duplicates of the .cpp versions, are excluded in src-IL/src/ProjectGenExcludeList.txt
Ogre is version 14.6.3 (Ogre 1.x, the "Tsathoggua" release, not Ogre-Next) from https://github.com/OGRECave/ogre/releases/tag/v14.6.3. Parts that are part of this code base: the core library (module Ogre), the render systems GL, GL3Plus, GLES2, Direct3D9, Direct3D11 and Vulkan with the OpenGL support library, the components Overlay, RTShaderSystem, MeshLodGenerator, Property, Paging, Terrain and Volume, the plugins ParticleFX, OctreeSceneManager, BSPSceneManager, PCZSceneManager, OctreeZone GLSLang (module OgrePlugin_GLSLangProgramManager), Assimp (module OgreCodec_Assimp) and DotScene (module OgrePlugin_DotScene), the command line tools XMLConverter, MeshUpgrader, AssimpConverter and VRMLConverter (modules OgreXMLConverter, OgreMeshUpgrader, OgreAssimpConverter and OgreVRMLConverter), and the media the core and the components need. Layout change against upstream: the files of Media/Main are in OgreMain/data, those of Media/RTShaderLib in Components/RTShaderSystem/data and those of Media/Terrain in Components/Terrain/data, so the build deploys them as the data of the modules Ogre, OgreRTShaderSystem and OgreTerrain (data/<module>, see GUCEF_deploy_data_files) and pluginglueOGRE mounts them in the VFS for the internal resource group of Ogre when it starts the run time shader system; a ProjectGenExcludeList.txt with "data" in each of the three module directories keeps OgreUnifiedShader.h out of the header lists. Media/packs (SdkTrays.zip, profiler.zip) stays where it was; on an upgrade copy the media of upstream into these data directories. The other parts of the upstream release (the Bites and Bullet components, the Python, Java and C# bindings, the Metal and Tiny render systems, the Cg, EXR, FreeImage, STBI and RsImage plugins, the exporters for DCC packages (Maya, XSI, Milkshape, Wings3D, Lightwave, dotXSI) and the Python script of the tools, samples, tests and documentation) are not part of it. The CMakeLists.txt of upstream are kept as _CMakeLists.txt. The headers which the upstream CMake build generates (OgreBuildSettings.h, OgreComponents.h, OgreExports.h, the export headers of the other modules, OgreRTShaderConfig.h and OgreGLES2Config.h, OgreVulkanExports.h and OgreGLSLangProgramManagerExports.h) are hand written equivalents in include/, in which the preprocessor selects what the platform decides. The Dear ImGui part of the Overlay component is not built: Dear ImGui is the separate module imgui (see below), which the GUI drivers draw. Ogre needs C++14, the modules set that with a CompilerFlags entry in their ModuleInfo.xml. The shared libraries of the modules are named after their module (libOgre.so, libOgreRenderSystem_GL3Plus.so, ...) and get the suffix _d in debug builds on all platforms, whereas the plugin loader of Ogre (Root::loadPlugin) only adds the suffix on Windows, so plugins are loaded by their full file name or through the GUCEF plugin groups. WebAssembly builds are static libraries (OGRE_STATIC_LIB), the plugins are installed by the application with Root::installPlugin. On Android the render system OgreRenderSystem_GLES2 (with OgreGLSupport) is a static library as well, linked into the application and handed to pluginglueOGRE with COgrePluginManager::RegisterLinkedOgrePlugin; the core library stays shared there. The directories RenderSystems/GLSupport_Wayland, RenderSystems/GL3Plus_Wayland and RenderSystems/GLES2_Wayland are not part of upstream: each holds only a ModuleInfo.xml and a ProjectGenInstructions.xml that lists the sources of GLSupport, GL3Plus or GLES2, for the Wayland flavour of the OpenGL render systems (modules OgreGLSupport_Wayland, built with OGRE_WAYLAND and the EGL/Wayland sources instead of EGL/X11 and X11, the equivalent of the upstream option OGRE_USE_WAYLAND, and OgreRenderSystem_GL3Plus_Wayland and OgreRenderSystem_GLES2_Wayland linked with it); on an upgrade regenerate the file lists of these instructions from the lists of the originals. Local edit marked "DV edit" in OgreMain/src/OgrePlatformInformation.cpp: on Android the CPU features and family come from the target architecture at compile time instead of the cpufeatures library of the NDK, which is not part of the build of this code base. Ogre does not decode PNG, JPEG and the other ordinary image formats in this code base: the STBI and FreeImage codec plugins are not part of it and the images are decoded by gucefIMAGE through the OgreCodec_GucefIMAGE plugin, only the codecs of OgreMain for the formats that are uploaded to the GPU as they are (DDS, KTX and PKM, ASTC, PVRTC) stay. Ogre does not read or write files by itself either, resources are read through gucefVFS by the archive factories of OgrePlugin_GucefVFS. Local edits marked "DV edit", all of them active when GUCEF_OGRE_NO_NATIVE_ARCHIVES is defined (include/OgreBuildSettings.h and the ModuleInfo.xml files of OgreMain and the BSPSceneManager plugin define it): OgreMain/src/OgreRoot.cpp does not register the FileSystem and Zip archive factories (the EmbeddedZip factory reads from memory only and stays) and creates its default log without a log file, OgreMain/include/OgreRoot.h has empty default file names for the plugin, configuration and log files of the Root constructor, PlugIns/BSPSceneManager/src/OgreQuake3Level.cpp does not write Quake3Level.log in debug builds. Further "DV edit" in OgreMain/include/OgreArchiveManager.h and src/OgreArchiveManager.cpp: removeArchiveFactory() and hasArchiveFactory(), so that a plugin which registered an archive factory can take it out again when it is uninstalled and can tell whether an archive type is taken
RmlUi: local edits marked "DV edit" in Include/RmlUi/Core/RmlUiMath.h (the types header is included last, since the templates of the vector and matrix types use what the math header declares), Matrix4.h/Vector2.h/Vector4.h (include the renamed RmlUiMath.h) and Source/Core/FontEngineDefault/FreeTypeInterface.cpp (compatibility with the older FreeType which is part of this code base)
cegui: local edit marked "DV edit" in cegui/include/CEGUI/Config.h, glibc iconv takes a non-const input buffer
libparsifal is version 1.1.0, the last release: local edit marked "DV edit" in include/libparsifal/xmlhash.h, on CPUs where alignment matters (GUCEF_CPU_REQUIRES_ALIGNED_ACCESS in common/include/gucef_platform.h) the block size of the pools of a hash table is rounded up to the alignment of a bucket, so every block starts aligned (the namedAtts table of int in parsifal.c made blocks of 20 bytes on 64-bit). For gucef_platform.h the module depends on gucefHeaders
libogg is version 1.3.6 from https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/ogg/libogg-1.3.6.tar.xz (sha256 of the tarball 5c8253428e181840cd20d41f3ca16557a9cc04bad4a3d04cce84808677fa1061, matches the xiph SHA256SUMS), only the library sources and public headers. include/ogg/config_types.h is the hand written stand-in for the file configure or CMake generates from config_types.h.in (marked "DV edit")
libvorbis is version 1.3.7 from https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/vorbis/libvorbis-1.3.7.tar.xz (sha256 of the tarball b33cc4934322bcbf6efcbacf49e3ca01aadbea4114ec9589d1b1e9d20f72954b, matches the xiph SHA256SUMS), lib/ sources of libvorbis, libvorbisfile and libvorbisenc (encoder kept) with the public headers, without the tools, tests and examples. Otherwise unmodified 1.3.7, with two local memory leak fixes marked "DV edit" (no upstream fix exists after 1.3.7): lib/vorbisenc.c vorbis_encode_residue_setup (the residue of surround encoders with 3 to 8 channels was allocated twice for one slot) and lib/vorbisfile.c _bisect_forward_serialno (the serialno list and headers leaked on the error paths of damaged chained files)
opusfile is version 0.12 from https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/opusfile-0.12.tar.gz (sha256 of the tarball 118d8601c12dd6a44f52423e68ca9083cc9f2bfe72da7a8c1acb22a80ae3550b, matches the xiph SHA256SUMS), unmodified decoder sources and opusfile.h, built against the libopus of the opus module. The HTTP URL streaming (http.c, wincerts.c, winerrno.h, opusurl) is left out so OpenSSL is not needed
dr_libs is commit 35b5c392cc15456736c440a68dbe073178bbffe0 of https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs, only dr_mp3.h (v0.7.4, sha256 f5c8020eeebb79877184432efdd2651f24869f5bb8f379d45450fd0aed1ee915) and dr_flac.h (v0.13.4, sha256 b8078eeb5d523502eb7964508cd7ec8450bc79d383bec90aa17fd9e2fefd9c24) plus the LICENSE, unmodified
pugixml is version 1.16 from https://github.com/zeux/pugixml/releases/tag/v1.16.0 (MIT licence, LICENSE.md), src/ with the library sources and the readme, unmodified; the module is a static library, built as C++17 (MyGUI 3.5.4 needs it, other modules can use it)
utfcpp (UTF8-CPP) is version 4.1.1 from https://github.com/nemtrif/utfcpp/releases/tag/v4.1.1 (Boost Software License 1.0, LICENSE), the source/ headers, unmodified, header only (MyGUI 3.5.4 needs it)
Ogre Vulkan: the render system (module OgreRenderSystem_Vulkan, upstream beta) loads the Vulkan functions at run time with the volk and uses the Vulkan Memory Allocator that are part of its sources, and takes the Vulkan headers from the module Vulkan-Headers.Includes; no Vulkan SDK is needed. The upstream CMake option of the window system is a define in its ModuleInfo.xml: VK_USE_PLATFORM_XLIB_KHR on Linux, VK_USE_PLATFORM_WIN32_KHR on Windows, VK_USE_PLATFORM_ANDROID_KHR on Android (a static library there, as OgreRenderSystem_GLES2). The Apple window of upstream (src/OgreVulkanWindowApple.mm, Objective-C++ on MoltenVK) is in the tree for the Apple platforms but not built yet: the generated build files only take C and C++ sources. The directory RenderSystems/Vulkan_Wayland is not part of upstream: it holds only a ModuleInfo.xml and a ProjectGenInstructions.xml that lists the sources of RenderSystems/Vulkan, for the Wayland flavour (module OgreRenderSystem_Vulkan_Wayland, VK_USE_PLATFORM_WAYLAND_KHR, the equivalent of the upstream option OGRE_USE_WAYLAND); on an upgrade regenerate its file list from the directory Vulkan. Its programs are SPIR-V that the plugin OgrePlugin_GLSLangProgramManager compiles from GLSL with glslang (the module glslang, see below). Local edits marked "DV edit" in the Vulkan render system: (1) src/OgreVulkanRenderSystem.cpp initConfigOptions() took front() of the empty list of devices when a Vulkan instance lists no device, which is undefined; the option "Device" then has no value and no possible values (found by reading the code: the drivers of this machine either list devices or fail to list them, in which case the plugin does not load). (2) include/OgreVulkanWindow.h overrides RenderWindow::setVSyncEnabled() and isVSyncEnabled(), which the window did not, so vsync could not be changed after the window was made and was reported off; src/OgreVulkanWindow.cpp setVSync() no longer destroys the swap chain at once (with an image acquired that crashed the driver in the frames after) but has it made again in acquireNextImage(), as for a swap chain that is out of date. (3) Clears and passes: upstream every render pass cleared its attachments when it began, and a clear only stored the values for the next pass, so a viewport that clears and draws nothing was never cleared and a pass after an earlier one on the same target in a frame (the GUI after the scene) wiped what was drawn before; and a draw after a change of target without the end of a frame went into the pass of the other target. Now every framebuffer has a second render pass that loads the attachments (VulkanFrameBufferDescValue::mRenderPassLoad, compatible with the clearing one), the pass clears only when a clear is pending (new attachments, a swap chain image just acquired, a clear of the whole target asked for), depth is stored, both passes have a dependency on earlier writes to the attachments, VulkanRenderSystem::clearFrameBuffer() begins the pass or clears the area of the viewport inside it with vkCmdClearAttachments (within the render area: a resized window keeps the size of its swap chain until it is made again), and the render system ends the open pass of another target before it draws (mOpenRenderPassDescriptor, beginRenderPassOfCurrentTarget()). Files: include/OgreVulkanRenderPassDescriptor.h, src/OgreVulkanRenderPassDescriptor.cpp, include/OgreVulkanRenderSystem.h, src/OgreVulkanRenderSystem.cpp, src/OgreVulkanWindow.cpp. The test "Pixels: viewports that only clear ..." of tests/guidriverOgre_TestApp fails without (3) and the vsync test without (2). (4) src/OgreVulkanRenderSystem.cpp getPipeline() and the draw: the viewport is dynamic pipeline state, set with vkCmdSetViewport after the pipeline is bound (upstream master made the same change later). The cache of pipelines is keyed by the handle of the render pass and not by the viewport, and the handle of the render pass of a destroyed render texture can come back for that of a new texture of another size, which then drew with the viewport of the old one (nothing, or a shifted picture). The test "Stage: the texture of another size is drawn over its whole size, after it was made again" of tests/AssetViewerLib_TestApp fails in about one of three Vulkan runs on lavapipe without (4). Pipelines made for a render pass that was destroyed stay in the cache: a new render pass with the same handle but other attachment formats would get an incompatible pipeline (upstream has the same behaviour). Local edits marked "DV edit" in PlugIns/GLSLang/src/OgreGLSLang.cpp: GlslangToSpv.h is included as SPIRV/GlslangToSpv.h (the source tree of glslang, not its installed layout), the default resource limits come from glslang (GetDefaultResources() of glslang/Public/ResourceLimits.h) instead of a table completed by memset and a size check for one layout of TBuiltInResource, and the layout location of a uniform is read through glslang::TType of glslang/Include/Types.h instead of copies of the private layouts of glslang::TQualifier and glslang::TType of one glslang version. Upgrade checklist: keep the edits of the render system and of the glslang plugin (check upstream first: the beta render system and the use of glslang by the plugin may have changed), regenerate the file list of Vulkan_Wayland, compare the export headers, run tests/guidriverOgre_TestApp with GUCEF_TEST_OGRE_RENDERER=Vulkan under Xvfb with VK_DRIVER_FILES naming lavapipe (lvp_icd.json) and once with VK_DRIVER_FILES naming the driver of a GPU that is not there
glslang is version 16.6.0 from https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang/releases/tag/16.6.0 (several licences: LICENSE.txt and the directory LICENSES; the parser glslang/MachineIndependent/glslang_tab.cpp is GPL-3.0-or-later with the Bison exception 2.2, which allows its use in programs under other licences). Part of this code base: the directories glslang and SPIRV with LICENSE.txt, LICENSES, README.md and CHANGES.md; the tests, the standalone tool, the gtests, kokoro, the build scripts and External are not. The module glslang (a static library, C++17) builds the GLSL front end, GenericCodeGen, OSDependent (Unix on Linux and Android, Windows on Windows), the SPIR-V back end and the default resource limits; the HLSL front end, the C interfaces, the JavaScript build and the SPIR-V optimiser (SPIRV-Tools is not part of this code base: ENABLE_OPT is not defined, so the SPIR-V is not optimised for size) are left out by ProjectGenInstructions.xml files. The CMakeLists.txt of upstream are kept as _CMakeLists.txt. Added file marked "DV edit": glslang/build_info.h, which the upstream CMake build generates from build_info.h.tmpl. Consumers include glslang/... and SPIRV/... from the directory of the module (an include directory of the module through Includes Source="Self"). Upgrade checklist: replace the two directories, write build_info.h with the new version, compare the source lists of glslang/_CMakeLists.txt and SPIRV/_CMakeLists.txt with the ProjectGenInstructions.xml files, build OgrePlugin_GLSLangProgramManager and run the Vulkan run of tests/guidriverOgre_TestApp
Ogre Assimp, DotScene and tools (step B2 of the Ogre integration): the plugins PlugIns/Assimp (module OgreCodec_Assimp, mesh codecs for the formats of the module assimp) and PlugIns/DotScene (module OgrePlugin_DotScene, the .scene codec, with the module pugixml, and with OgreTerrain where OgreComponents.h enables the Terrain component, so on every platform but WebAssembly) and the tools Tools/XMLConverter (OgreXMLConverter, with pugixml), Tools/MeshUpgrader (OgreMeshUpgrader, with OgreMeshLodGenerator), Tools/AssimpConverter (OgreAssimpConverter, with OgreCodec_Assimp and OgreRTShaderSystem) and Tools/VRMLConverter (OgreVRMLConverter, with the vrmllib of upstream; the upstream target is named VRMLConverter), with Tools/Readme.md. The tools are executables for Linux and Windows; the plugins are shared libraries (static libraries on Android and WebAssembly). The CMakeLists.txt of upstream are kept as _CMakeLists.txt. The export headers OgreAssimpExports.h and OgreDotScenePluginExports.h, which the upstream CMake build generates, are hand written equivalents in include/ (as OgreGLSLangProgramManagerExports.h). The Python script PlugIns/DotScene/misc/validate.py and Tools/XMLConverter/docs/validate.py of upstream are not part of this code base. Local edit marked "DV edit" in Tools/AssimpConverter/main.cpp: the converter is linked with OgreCodec_Assimp and installs the plugin object (AssimpPlugin) itself with Root::installPlugin instead of loading the library Codec_Assimp from the PluginFolder of a plugins.cfg, since the plugin libraries of this code base are named after their module (and get the suffix _d in debug builds) and there is no plugins.cfg. A second "DV edit" in the same file: the Ogre core of this code base does not register the FileSystem archive factory (GUCEF_OGRE_NO_NATIVE_ARCHIVES; the archive type FileSystem of OgrePlugin_GucefVFS reads through the VFS), so the converter makes a FileSystemArchiveFactory itself and registers it with the ArchiveManager before it adds its resource location. Local edits marked "DV edit" in PlugIns/Assimp/src/AssimpLoader.cpp: OgreIOStream::Seek() also seeks from the current position and from the end (upstream only from the start), which the zip reader of Assimp needs for 3MF packages; and the vertex and index buffers take the usage and shadow settings of the mesh (MeshManager::load(), as the mesh serializer does) instead of always static write only without a shadow, so tools can load meshes with copies in memory to read the geometry back on every render system; the defaults are unchanged. The other tools and plugins are unmodified; they read and write plain files with their own streams. The generator makes every Executable module of Windows a WIN32 (GUI subsystem) program while these tools have a main() function: not checked on Windows. tests/OgreTools_TestApp runs the tools, the plugins and the glTF round trips headless.
assimp (Open Asset Import Library) is version 6.0.5 from https://github.com/assimp/assimp/archive/refs/tags/v6.0.5.tar.gz (sha256 of the tarball edf3749559c2b7d1f758ffb66fc5bec62186221e623b7f2e8969f17ee46ecb6f; BSD 3-clause licence, LICENSE; the contrib libraries keep their own licences next to them), the version OGRE 14.6.3 builds for its Assimp plugin. It is configured as Ogre configures it (CMake/Dependencies.cmake of Ogre: shared build, ASSIMP_NO_EXPORT, ASSIMP_BUILD_OGRE_IMPORTER OFF, ASSIMP_BUILD_IFC_IMPORTER OFF), and the M3D, USD and VRML importers, which are off by default upstream, stay off, as does the draco compression of glTF: so the module is import only, with the importers 3DS, 3MF, AC, AMF, ASE, ASSBIN, B3D, BLEND, BVH, COB, COLLADA, CSM, DXF, FBX, GLTF (glTF 1 and 2), HMP, IQM, IRR, IRRMESH, LWO, LWS, MD2, MD3, MD5, MDC, MDL, MMD, MS3D, NDO, NFF, OBJ, OFF, OPENGEX, PLY, Q3BSP, Q3D, RAW, SIB, SMD, STL, TERRAGEN, X, X3D, XGL and the 3D (Unreal) importer; it is a shared library (a static library on Android and WebAssembly) and defines ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_<format>_IMPORTER for the importers that are left out (OGRE, IFC, M3D, USD, VRML, C4D) and ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_EXPORT. Kept of the release: code/ (without its CMakeLists.txt, which is kept as code/_CMakeLists.txt, the source list of the module), include/, LICENSE, CREDITS, Readme.md and the contrib directories Open3DGC (glTF compression, ASSIMP_IMPORTER_GLTF_USE_OPEN3DGC), earcut-hpp (triangulation), openddlparser (OpenGEX), poly2tri (Blender), rapidjson (glTF), stb (embedded textures), unzip (zip based formats; it uses the zlib module) and utf8cpp. Not part of this code base: test/, samples/, doc/, port/, tools/, fuzz/, packaging/, scripts/, cmake-modules/, the contrib directories googletest, zlib (the module zlib is used: ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_OWN_ZLIB), pugixml (the module pugixml, version 1.16, is used instead of the bundled 1.15; the include style #include <pugixml.hpp> is the same and the bundled copy only differed in the export macro of its pugiconfig.hpp), and rapidjson/include/rapidjson/msinttypes (stdint.h and inttypes.h for Microsoft compilers before 2010, excluded in ProjectGenExcludeList.txt: on other compilers they would be found before the system headers of the same name), draco, tinyusdz, meshlab (the VRML importer), clipper (used only by the IFC importer), zip (only for the 3MF exporter) and android-cmake. The directories of the left out importers (AssetLib/Ogre, IFC, M3D, USD, C4D) and AssetLib/VRML (of which only VrmlConverter.cpp is built: upstream compiles it as part of the X3D importer, and with ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_VRML_IMPORTER it is a stub; the VRML parser of meshlab is not part of this code base) and of the exporters (AssetLib/Assjson, AssetLib/Assxml, AssetLib/Step, code/Pbrt, and the *Exporter and *FileWriter files in the other directories, Common/Exporter.cpp and CApi/AssimpCExport.cpp) are in the tree but excluded from the build by ProjectGenExcludeList.txt and ProjectGenInstructions.xml files. Added files marked "DV added": include/assimp/config.h and include/assimp/revision.h (hand written equivalents of what the CMake configure step of upstream makes from config.h.in and revision.h.in: no double precision, git hash 0, branch empty, package version 0) and include/ModuleInfo.xml (the header module assimp.Includes, so that dependents can include <assimp/scene.h>). Upstream is built there as C++17 with the compiler flags of the other third party modules (hidden symbol visibility, only the API functions of the headers are exported). On Windows a user of the shared library defines ASSIMP_DLL (the modules OgreCodec_Assimp and OgreAssimpConverter do). Local edit marked "DV edit" in code/AssetLib/STL/STLLoader.cpp: a facet whose stored normal is zero (or not a number) gets the normal of its vertices (RepairFacetNormal(), binary and ASCII files); STL writers may leave the normal zero for the reader to compute, and upstream copies it as it is, which draws the facet black (upstream leaves it to the FindInvalidData post processing step, which the Fast preset of the Ogre loader does not run). Upgrade checklist: keep that edit (check upstream first), replace code/ (keeping the ProjectGen* files and the _CMakeLists.txt copies), include/ and the contrib directories, write config.h and revision.h again (new version in revision.h), compare the importer lists of code/_CMakeLists.txt with the exclusions, build OgreCodec_Assimp and run tests/OgreTools_TestApp
Vulkan-Headers is the release vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 from https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers (Apache-2.0 OR MIT, LICENSE.md and the directory LICENSES): only the C headers (include/vulkan/*.h and include/vk_video/*.h) with LICENSE.md, LICENSES and README.md; the C++ bindings (vulkan.hpp and the other .hpp files, the C++ modules), the registry and the tests are not part of it. Module Vulkan-Headers.Includes (header only)
msdfgen is version 1.13 from https://github.com/Chlumsky/msdfgen/releases/tag/v1.13 (MIT licence, LICENSE.txt), the tag MyGUI 3.5.4 pins in its own build; msdfgen 1.13.1 is a later patch release of upstream and is not used. Part of this code base: core/ (module msdfgen-core), ext/ (module msdfgen-ext) and the public headers msdfgen.h and msdfgen-ext.h, with LICENSE.txt, README.md and CHANGELOG.md; the sources are unmodified (no main.cpp, resources, icon, batch, cmake and vcpkg files). Both modules are static libraries (so the export macros are empty), the configuration of the upstream CMake build is made with the defines of the ModuleInfo.xml files: MSDFGEN_USE_CPP11 (a layout switch of the public headers: MyGUI.Engine defines it as well), MSDFGEN_PUBLIC= and MSDFGEN_EXT_PUBLIC= (empty), MSDFGEN_EXTENSIONS, MSDFGEN_DISABLE_SVG, MSDFGEN_DISABLE_PNG and MSDFGEN_DISABLE_VARIABLE_FONTS (the FreeType 2.6.3 of this code base has no variable font interface); Skia (MSDFGEN_USE_SKIA), TinyXML 2, libpng and OpenMP are not used. msdfgen-ext uses the freetype module and needs no other library or operating system package. MyGUI.Engine uses both modules (MYGUI_MSDF_FONTS in MyGUI_Config.h). The MSDF fragment shaders of MyGUI (Msdf_OpenGL3_FP.glsl, Msdf_OpenGLES_FP.glsl, Msdf_Ogre_FP.glsl and Msdf_Ogre_FP.hlsl, from Media/Demos/Demo_MsdfFont of MyGUI 3.5.4) are in MyGUIEngine/data, unmodified
libpq is the client library of PostgreSQL 18.7 from https://ftp.postgresql.org/pub/source/v18.7/postgresql-18.7.tar.bz2 (sha256 of the tarball 441dfae4280cae3e0425e5f876f80559fb0731c140f1aae22b3e5a54d0411bfd; PostgreSQL licence, COPYRIGHT), a static library (module libpq) linked into dbpluginPOSTGRESQL. Kept of the release, unmodified and in their places: COPYRIGHT, README.md, src/interfaces/libpq (the sources and headers of the library and its README, without the GSSAPI files fe-gssapi-common.* and fe-secure-gssapi.c, the tests, po/ and the build files), the files of src/common and src/port it uses (base64, encnames, ip, jsonapi, link-canary, md5_common, pg_prng, saslprep, scram-common, string, unicode_norm and wchar with md5_int.h, sha1_int.h and sha2_int.h; cryptohash_openssl and hmac_openssl where OpenSSL is used, cryptohash, hmac, md5, sha1 and sha2 elsewhere; chklocale, getpeereid, inet_net_ntop, pgstrcasecmp, pg_strong_random, snprintf, strerror, strlcat, strlcpy, timingsafe_bcmp and pthread-win32.h; the Windows files of src/port that upstream builds on Windows), and the headers of src/include they include (with port/win32 and port/win32_msvc for Windows): the members a link of libpq pulls from libpgcommon and libpgport. The headers the configure step of upstream generates are hand written equivalents marked "DV added", in which the preprocessor selects what the platform decides: src/include/pg_config.h (the values for Linux, Android, Apple and Windows, version 18.7), src/include/pg_config_os.h (includes the port header of the platform, the header configure links there) and src/port/pg_config_paths.h (the installation directories of an upstream build, prefix /usr/local/pgsql; libpq only uses SYSCONFDIR, to find pg_service.conf when PGSYSCONFDIR is not set). No script of the release (configure, meson, the perl generators) was run. Configuration: TLS through the OpenSSL 3 of the system on Linux (the module links ssl and crypto, as curl and codecspluginOPENSSL do), no TLS on Windows; no GSSAPI, LDAP, NLS or libcurl (so no built in OAuth device flow); strlcat, strlcpy, timingsafe_bcmp and getpeereid are always the replacements of src/port, whatever the C library has. ProjectGenInstructions.xml files (DV added) in src/interfaces/libpq, src/common and src/port select the OpenSSL or the built in hashes and the Windows files per platform. The Windows configuration follows the meson build of upstream and has not been built. Upgrade checklist: replace the kept files from the new tarball, compare the meson.build files of src/interfaces/libpq, src/common and src/port with the selection, compare src/include/pg_config.h.in with pg_config.h (new or removed symbols, the version numbers), link libpq against all of libpgcommon_shlib and libpgport_shlib to find the members it pulls, then build dbpluginPOSTGRESQL and run tests/dbpluginPOSTGRESQL_TestApp with GUCEF_TEST_POSTGRESQL set.
ufbx is version 0.23.1 from https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/archive/refs/tags/v0.23.1.tar.gz (sha256 of the tarball 21edd1021dfb430e37aa6214c9b3bbaa5634b1859cbbef7231e738af4f19c956; MIT or Unlicense at your option, LICENSE), the newest tag at the time of vendoring: ufbx.h and ufbx.c unmodified, plus the LICENSE and README.md, built as a static library (module ufbx). The FBX importer plugin assetpluginFBX of the asset converter uses it
cgltf is version 1.15 from https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf/archive/refs/tags/v1.15.tar.gz (sha256 of the tarball 84e352092e5cd6aab7f66de62ddb66beb5e6f18d412ca9d12950d7a55bfef25a; MIT licence, LICENSE), the newest release at the time of vendoring: cgltf.h unmodified, plus the LICENSE and README.md. The upstream header is a single file library, so the module has one own file, src/cgltf.c, that defines CGLTF_IMPLEMENTATION and includes the header; built as a static library (module cgltf). The glTF plugin assetpluginGLTF of the asset converter uses it to read and to validate (cgltf_write.h of upstream is not vendored: the exporter writes its own deterministic JSON)

Note for MS Windows builds: 
- to build the DirectInput dependent code you must have the DirectX SDK installed on your system.
Such external binary dependencies are managed via the ModuleInfo.xml under /dependencies/external
- Note that for some of the dependencies you need to have the Windows SDK installed. Said SDK needs to be of the correct recent version to avoid build issues.
Incorrect older SDKs on Windows can cause build issues due to certain APIs not being available because of NTDDI_VERSION based exclusions.
